units.source_text: 从一株树干到另一株树干，拴上好几层竹子和木棒，像晒竿一样，把稻子挂在上面晾干，看起来仿佛立着一面高大的稻草屏风。当地土话把它叫做“哈蒂”。

en.t: From one tree trunk to another, several tiers of bamboo and wooden poles were tied like drying rods, and rice was hung on them to dry, making it look as if a tall screen of rice straw were standing there. In the local dialect it was called a "hatte."

units.source_text: ——岛村他们经过的路旁，老乡也做了这种“哈蒂”。

en.t: Along the road Shimamura and the others passed, the local farmers had also made this kind of "hatte."
